teaser: Five-forty in the morning, before the house stirs, and you are listing tomorrow's goodwills — who needs calling, who needs thanking. You are a life path 11, carrying a pull toward something larger than the ordinary, and an ESFJ, built to keep people fed and held together. The particular thing about this crossing is the gap between the two: eleven asks you to be a signal, something others feel before they understand it, while the ESFJ in you wants that signal made useful, turned into casseroles and class schedules and shown-up birthdays. The glow has somewhere to go here. It rarely stays abstract.
excerpt: The card is handwritten, mailed early, exactly the right thing said.
